## Loading packages

```{r packages}
library(here)
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Read data
```{r packages}
Rwanda_raw <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Rwanda/Main dataset.dta")
Rwanda_Section_A <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Rwanda/Section A.dta")
```

## Yoink data we want
```{r packages}
Rwanda_filtered <- Rwanda_raw[,c(1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 724, 10, 13, 15, 24, 30, 64, 65, 
                                 69, 70, 71, 87, 88, 112, 445, 451, 454, 455, 457, 
                                 456, 463, 464, 465, 466, 467, 468, 469, 481, 
                                 483, 484, 486, 487)]
```

## Save as csv
```{r packages}
write.csv(Rwanda_filtered, "Data/Processed/Rwanda_filtered.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
